visual_identity.core_identity: A flowing mass of ordinary dungeon rats whose individual bodies remain readable while the group moves like a living tide.
visual_identity.silhouette: Many low rat bodies arranged in one directional stream, tails and snouts creating motion without becoming a black pile.
visual_identity.body_shape: Repeated small four-legged rodent forms in varied running poses; no giant leader.

scene_identity.size_impression: The swarm covers a broad strip of floor while individual rats remain clearly small.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Each rat remains supported by floor, debris, or edge surfaces; the group follows one coherent route.

known_failure_modes.symptom: rats merge into one unreadable heap
known_failure_modes.correction: separate bodies with white gaps and one directional stream
